profile.headline: Making infrastructure invisible and the hidden obvious.
profile.summary:
Software developer for enterprise and handheld software.
XML Tools and systems evangelist.
IOT fleet management and custom device agent development.
Performance analysis and optimizations. 
Global view with detail focus.


Specialties: Enterprise systems, Cloud Computing and Containers, Publishing and fulfillment, Global Data collection and deployment, XML systems and technologies.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Android Development · Cloud Computing · Internet of Things (IoT) · Architecture

positions.title: Sr Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Outcome Health merged with PatientPoint in March, 2021
Responsible for Android System development, integrations with backend services, IoT 'fleet' management.  

Developed Mobile Device Management solutions for Android, Linux, and windows 'kiosk' devices utilizing AWS IOT services and custom native device agents controlling approx 100,000 remote devices worldwide.

positions.title: CTO and architectual advisor.
positions.description:
I co-founded Nexstra, Inc in 2002 to provide digital and physical fulfillment and ecommerce solutions for the software industry.   After developing the two flagship products, nCommerce and nConnect, I have retained an advisory role to provide architectural vision and direction for  current and future products and services.

http://www.nexstra.com

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.locationName: "Virtual" location reporting to San Carlos, CA

projects.title: xmlsh - A command line shell for XML Based on the philosophy and design of the Unix Shells
projects.description:
I created "xmlsh" in 2008 as an open source project while at Epocrates, Inc to implement complex clinical document processing workflows. When workflow processing time exceeds publication intervals, traditional approaches simply don't work. Independently developed, a similar architecture to address the same issues become the "XProc" W3C Standard. 

https://www.balisage.net/Proceedings/vol4/author-pkg/Lee01/BalisageVol4-Lee01.html

projects.title: xmlsh
projects.description: A scripting environment designed after the Unix Shells with deep integration to XML technolgoies
